compositionRules: Left-weighted layouts; avoid centering text in every scene
Records occupy the left two-thirds; citation bottom-left, above captions
One focal point per visual state
archivalTreatment: Show archival images unaltered except crop and slow push-in; always credit; never colorize
documentTreatment: Typeset verbatim excerpts on paper, footnoted 'not a facsimile'; highlight, then dim unrelated lines
mapTreatment: Schematic and labeled 'not to scale' until real cartography with verified locations exists
timelineTreatment: Ordinal spacing; marker shape encodes date precision; undocumented periods shown dashed

reconstructionTreatment.description: Simple line illustrations only, labeled for the whole shot; never photoreal; never presented as the real place

cameraRules: No shake, no whip pans, no constant zoom
transitionRules: Fade through black only at act breaks
negativeConstraints: No generic police lights or red/blue flashing
No blood splatter or gore imagery
No neon grids, floating glass cards, or random particles
No fake newspaper headlines or fake evidence documents
No centered text in every scene
